description: Live session parameters (volume, deck feedback, amplitude guard) and other session state outside the preset.

domains.title: Runtime (session) parameters
domains.write: runtime.set {volume?, feedback?, feedback_coeff?, store_feedback_coeff?, volume_center?, volume_range?}; max_volume, amplitude_limit, amplitude_gate_enabled, deck_scaling: REST POST /set_runtime_parameters only (not in runtime.set args)
domains.key_space: field names (state_changed keys = the updated field names, entry null)
domains.shape: bare values: GET {volume_level, volume_center, effective_volume_center, output_scale, volume_range, deck_feedback_coefficient, amplitude_limit?, amplitude_gate_enabled?}; SET body uses volume (not volume_level)
domains.stored_vs_effective: Session state, not preset data (not undoable; never persisted in the preset except store_feedback_coeff, see deck_feedback_coefficient). volume_center is reported and set in BARE units; the engine value is bare x output_scale (effective_volume_center). The slider level survives every load kind.

fields.name: volume
fields.meaning: SET name of the slider level: amplitude = volume_center * volume_range^((level-64)/63), or the legacy max_volume^(level/127) when volume_center == 0. Not the load-time 'volume' anchor.

fields.name: volume_level
fields.range: integer 0..127; a first load starts at 64
fields.meaning: GET name of the same slider level (session state owned by set_runtime_parameters; no load kind changes it).

fields.name: feedback
fields.units: 0 = silence; 1-127 MIDI-style level (64 -> 1.0, 127 -> 8.0, 1 -> ~0.125); other values a direct coefficient
fields.meaning: Deck feedback coefficient by level (auto-detected mapping); scales piano-pitch resonance feedback only.

fields.name: feedback_coeff
fields.meaning: Bypasses the feedback level mapping; the two-layer FE slider sends effective = stored_coeff(preset) x slider multiplier. Lower feedback = louder / sharper attack but stable (a damping coefficient; risk = clipping).

fields.name: deck_feedback_coefficient
fields.meaning: GET: the live engine deck feedback coefficient (RuntimeParameters default 1.0); feedback = feedin x this scalar on piano-pitch rows.

fields.name: volume_center
fields.units: bare amplitude coefficient at level 64 (FE sends exp((presetVolume-100)/8), 1.0 at the default init volume 100)
fields.range: 0 selects the legacy formula; > 0 the sensitivity formula
fields.meaning: Level-64 anchor in bare units; GET returns the bare value so it can be SET back unchanged.

fields.name: effective_volume_center
fields.meaning: The raw engine value the kernel uses (read-only).

fields.name: output_scale
fields.meaning: The active preset's Layer B scale (see derived.json output_level).

fields.name: volume_range
fields.range: default 10; at level 127 the coefficient is center*range, at 0 center/range
fields.meaning: Volume sensitivity; per session only, never persisted in presets, global across library preset switches.

fields.name: max_volume
fields.meaning: Changes the coefficient only while volume_center == 0 (legacy formula); written read-modify-write.

fields.name: amplitude_limit
fields.meaning: Runtime crash-guard ceiling: the in-kernel guard trips (self-heals) when |displacement| > amplitude_limit; per session.

fields.name: amplitude_gate_enabled
fields.units: bool (0/1 on SET and in the event, bool on GET)
fields.meaning: Toggles only the amplitude branch of the crash-guard; the isnan check stays active unconditionally; per session.

fields.name: deck_scaling
fields.meaning: Engine-only re-pack of the deck with these factors (the legacy MIDI CC knobs); the stored rows are untouched.

domains.title: Stored per-preset feedback baseline
domains.read: REST GET /health stored_feedback_coeff (no registry command; runtime.get deck_feedback_coefficient is the live engine value)
domains.key_space: global for the active preset (state_changed keys [])
domains.stored_vs_effective: PRESET data, in memory until /save_preset (model_parameters.deck_feedback_coefficient); undoable; 409 on a read-only original. The live engine value is effective = stored x the FE slider multiplier. switch_preset applies the target preset's value.

fields.name: store_feedback_coeff
fields.meaning: The 'Set' / fold button value: the new per-preset stored feedback baseline.

domains.title: Fix-MIDI velocity clamp
domains.read: none in the registry; REST GET /get_fix_velocity
domains.write: none in the registry; REST POST /set_fix_velocity {enabled, level} (both required)
domains.stored_vs_effective: Session state on the running engine: not preset-persisted, not reset on preset switch, reset to {enabled: false, level: 64} on backend restart. Clamps only MIDI-source NOTE_ON velocities.

fields.name: enabled
fields.meaning: When true, MIDI-source NOTE_ON velocities are clamped to level.

fields.name: level
fields.meaning: The clamped velocity (0 = silent note, 127 = fortissimo).

domains.title: Per-pitch excitation type (hammer / bow)
domains.read: none in the registry; REST GET /get_excitation_mode
domains.write: none in the registry; REST POST /set_excitation_mode {pitch, mode: hammer|bow|0|1}
domains.stored_vs_effective: Session state on the live engine, not preset-persisted.

fields.name: modes
fields.meaning: Excitation type of each pitch of the active preset.
